description: Cycling is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of the Premier and Cabinet. South Australian residents riding a bicycle in a typical week. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of the Premier and Cabinet. Its tags are cycling, sasp. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2015-07-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
